theorem_rows.name: forced_parity_bad_tail
theorem_rows.statement: For odd P and tail prime q, a=P-q is even; hence m=P+a+t is even exactly when t is odd, so every odd-t slot is forced BadTail.

theorem_rows.name: residual_lpf_layer
theorem_rows.statement: Every BadTail not forced by parity has even t, odd composite m, and an odd least prime factor ell<=sqrt(m)<sqrt(5P/4+2).

theorem_rows.name: fixed_q_ell_nonreuse
theorem_rows.statement: For fixed sign, q, and ell, the product interval has length P/(q ell)<1, so a residual least-prime-factor layer contributes at most one slot.

theorem_rows.name: remaining_prime_vs_forced_plus_residual
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof still needs square-anchor primes to beat forced parity slots plus residual LPF layers, or a PDEC/SAE return from residual over-density.

plain_conclusion: `BadTail` 已进一步分解为两个刚性层：奇数 `t` 槽由奇偶性强制成为偶余因子坏槽；剩余坏槽只能发生在偶数 `t` 上，并且由一个奇最小素因子 `ell<=sqrt(m)` 解释。固定 `(q,ell)` 在同一侧不能复用槽，因为对应乘积区间长度小于 `1`。因此剩余硬点变为：平方锚素数数必须压过强制奇偶坏槽与残余 LPF 层；若残余层过密，则它应回流为低模最小因子 PDEC/SAE。

decision_rows.meaning: 奇数 t 槽必为偶余因子，因而必是 BadTail。
非奇偶强制的 BadTail 已压成互不复用的最小素因子层。
仍需全局证明平方锚素数数压过强制奇偶坏槽与残余 LPF 层总量。
若残余 LPF 层过密，必须抽取固定低模最小因子相位缺陷。
本步只关闭 BadTail 内部分层，不关闭全局行/列命题。
